message: You know, sometimes I find myself chuckling at the thought of how unprepared I can be for the little surprises life throws my way. Just last week, I rummaged through my pantry looking for snacks, only to realize I had an abundance of expired granola bars! 😄 It’s a gentle reminder that getting ready doesn't have to be a chore—especially when it can be a fun family project. If you're curious about how to turn preparedness into a family activity, there’s a great resource out there for kids. It might even spark some laughter along the way! What’s your best ‘oops’ preparedness moment?
